digest.key_takeaway:
Build a stateless MCP v2 server in TypeScript. A hands-on guide to the MCP TypeScript v2 SDK — the new @modelcontextprotocol/server packages, createMcpHandler, Standard Schema tools, and what replaces session handling.


  
  
  Introduction


MCP v2 is final. Protocol revision 2026-07-28 shipped, and the TypeScript SDK shipped with it: @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.0.0 and its companion packages are on npm as stable releases.

If you want a v2 server running today, this guide gets you there. The fastest path is one command:



npx @agentailor/create-mcp-server@0.7.0 --name=fetch-mcp-server

articles.title: AWS Introduces Free Sandbox Environments for Workshops
articles.summary: AWS Builder Center now offers free, time-limited sandbox environments for workshops, so developers no longer need to use their own AWS account and credit card or worry about unexpected charges. This has been a long-standing request from the community and removes one of the biggest friction points for practitioners learning new AWS technologies. By Renato Losio

articles.title: Honeywell’s Warehouse Automation Business Consolidates into Trew
articles.summary: Warehouse automation solutions are moving into a new wave of consolidation as technology vendors add new features and functions to address the increasing demands of e-commerce, manufacturing, retail and logistics firms. Customers are increasingly turning to an integrated approach, where robotics, material handling, software and lifecycle services are all provided by a single vendor, rather than developing a set of stand-alone solutions.

articles.title: Terraform Introduces tfpolicy, an HCL-based Policy-as-Code Framework
articles.summary: HashiCorp has introduced tfpolicy, a new HCL-based policy-as-code framework for Terraform, now available in public beta within HCP Terraform. It is designed to simplify and modernize infrastructure governance by integrating policy creation and enforcement directly into Terraform workflows, eliminating the need for separate tools and languages. By Sergio De Simone

articles.title: I have trained a model to predict my blood sugar [P]
articles.summary: It's an encoder-only transformer that consumes past(blood glucose + carbs + insulin) and future(carbs + insulin) and predicts future blood glucose for the next 2 hours. Announced meals and boluses/basal are used to condition its predictions. The context size is variable (8 - 24 hours), and model can work in autoregressive mode to predict the next >2 hours. It also predicts time by looking at the context, but it never consumes time. The architecture is BERT-style: bidirectional attention with future BG masked. articles.title: When the Code Becomes the CEO: Why Your Next Manager Might Be a Decentralized Agentic Loop
articles.summary:
In five to ten years, the sharpest manager in your company might not be human, might not sleep, and might exist entirely in shared GPU memory. This is the systems-level view of the algorithmic corporation — why middle management collapses into a protocol, what breaks in the current AI stack, and what has to be built for autonomous agents to actually run a business.
